subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Commitment Pledges for the Environment
description: A fast breakdown of Commitment Pledges for the Environment for builders.

hook.text: Households that signed a pledge to reduce water use cut consumption 12% more than those who received information.

buildup.text: Public commitments activate consistency motivation. Once you declare a goal, internal pressure to follow through.

discovery.text: Cialdini showed that commitments work best when they're active, public, and voluntary.

twist.text: Digital pledges are weaker than handwritten ones. The physical act of writing and signing increases the psychological.

climax.text: Environmental pledges are low-cost policy tools. They translate vague intentions into specific commitments that create.

punchline.text: Sign the pledge. The act of signing changes behavior by itself.

quiz.question: What makes commitment pledges most effective?
options: They must be legally binding to work
They work best when active, public, and voluntary
Digital pledges are more effective than handwritten ones
